title: Efficacy and safety of deferiprone for thalassemia: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.

evidence.reason: Inventory must identify exactly k distinct trials

answer.design_quote: Eligible randomized controlled trials (RCTs) enrolled thalassemia patients receiving iron chelation therapy and compared DFP (alone or in combination) with deferoxamine, deferasirox, placebo, or no chelation.
answer.k_quote: Twenty-three RCTs ( n = 1,005) met the inclusion criteria; 18 were included in the meta-analysis.
